title: Provider Manual: Panel Capacity under the Primary Care Provider Assignment
content:
**Chapter: Panel size.** A practice accepts members under the Primary Care Provider Assignment only up to the maximum panel size of its practice type.

### Panel count

The panel count of a provider is the number of Primary Care Provider Assignments, across all members, that name that provider's NPI and are in pending-effective or active status on the handling date.

### Rule

1. A provider accepts a new assignment only while its panel count is **below** the practice type's maximum panel size.
2. Where the practice type has the family panel exception, a member may join a full panel when a household member already holds a pending-effective or active assignment with the same provider. The exception never applies to auto-assignment.
3. A request to a full panel without the exception is not recorded; the member is offered other open providers.

### Maximum panel size and family exception

| Practice type | Maximum panel size (members per provider NPI) | Family panel exception |
|---|---|---|
| Standard Primary Care Provider | 2,500 | Yes |
| Pediatric Primary Care Provider | 2,000 | Yes |
| OB/GYN Primary Care Provider | 1,500 | No |
| Federally Qualified Health Center Home | 3,000 | Yes |
| Patient-Centered Medical Home Practice | 2,200 | Yes |
| Specialist Serving as PCP | 600 | No |
| Health Home Lead Provider | 1,200 | Yes |

(Written without separators: 2500, 2000, 1500, 3000, 2200, 600 and 1200.)

### Boundary cases (hypothetical panel counts)

| Practice type | Panel count on the handling date | Panel open to a new assignment |
|---|---|---|
| Specialist Serving as PCP | 599 | Yes — below 600 |
| Specialist Serving as PCP | 600 | No — the panel is full |
| Standard Primary Care Provider | 2,500 | No, unless the family panel exception applies |

### Full panel: decision table

| Practice type has the exception | Household member holds a pending-effective or active assignment with this provider | Assignment made by auto-assignment | Result |
|---|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes | No | The member may join the full panel |
| Yes | Yes | Yes | The exception does not apply |
| Yes | No | — | The exception does not apply |
| No | — | — | The exception does not apply |

Where the exception does not apply to a full panel, the request is not recorded and the member is offered other open providers.
